page.headline: How to Wear a Lapel Pin on a Suit, Blazer or Shirt
page.title: How to Wear a Lapel Pin With or Without a Jacket
page.description: A lapel pin sits high on your left lapel, near the buttonhole. On a shirt, choose a firm spot. If a wide logo tilts, check the fabric, post and clutch.
page.excerpt: A company pin can sit level on a blazer lapel yet pull a shirt collar down. When a wide logo tilts but the cloth stays flat, check whether the design is pivoting around a single post.

faq.question: Can I wear more than one lapel pin?
faq.answer: Yes. On a casual jacket, space pins so each design shows and the backs don’t overlap. For uniforms, follow the dress code.

faq.question: Can I use one lapel buttonhole for a two-post pin?
faq.answer: Only if both posts line up when the pin is level and both clutches sit flat without slipping through. A post outside the opening needs a separate pinhole.
